answer: Give each identity a forge that only burns basalt-hard work credits: credits are earned by completing real tasks for strangers, expire at epoch end, and cannot be bought. A random audit re-runs a sample of each agent's claimed work; failures slash its deposit and drain its credits. An honest agent tends one small oasis of earned credit, while a sybil farmer must redo full verified work for every clone, every epoch, or watch its fakes wither.
